The Mellin weight coefficient is reduced with C=6*pi^2.

schema_transport.phase_field: P39 is required by the legacy research-run-evidence/v1 schema; the calculation and raw result have numbered_phase=null.
schema_transport.check_prefix: P39.rawc.gamma1.* IDs are schema-transport aliases only; authoritative raw-result IDs begin rawc.gamma1 and this creates no numbered phase.

payload.computed_scope: For the declared fixed c_p reference at Q0=-4, this records the exact nonzero-lambda left-boundary identity and two punctured-lambda operator bounds per unit declared minus-tail L2(f) norm. The lambda-zero interval data apply conditionally to any sign-changing zero inside each full inherited bracket, without a uniqueness claim.

two_lambda_operator_bounds_per_unit_L2_f.scope: The two signs have the same absolute-value operator envelope; these are bounds, not evaluated Gamma_1 values of a constructed nonzero-lambda solution.

certificate.backend: python-flint 0.9.0 / FLINT-Arb; 80/120-digit tiers are same-backend consistency refinements, not independent validation.
